text: The project is the first in Pakistan to formalize contractual water service obligations to Farmers' Organizations and to develop the Sindh Strategic Water Plan. It includes a Hydro-Agro Informatics program and a smart-subsidy scheme targeting 220,000 acres. Early milestones include the approval of the Sindh Water Policy, establishment of governance arrangements, and initiation of environmental and social safeguard frameworks.

metadata.solution_name: Sindh Water and Agriculture Transformation Project (SWAT)
